title: CORE-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Code Retrieval in the Era of Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2606.11864v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code retrieval is becoming central to coding agents, but agentic coding requires more than matching a natural-language query to an isolated snippet. Given a user request, a coding agent needs to navigate a concrete repository state, locate relevant files and functions, gather supporting context, and filter similar in-repository distractors. Existing code retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate docstring-to-function or snippet-level matching, thereby missing this requirement-driven repository search problem. To address this gap, we introduce CORE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for code retrieval in the era of agentic coding. CORE-Bench evaluates code retrieval ability at three levels: code understanding, issue-to-edit localization, and broader context retrieval. Built from curated code-search tasks and SWE-bench-series instances, CORE-Bench contains over 180K queries and 106K broader-context relevance labels. Experiments with represent

translated_title: CORE-Bench：智能体编程时代代码检索的综合基准
translated_abstract: 代码检索正成为编码智能体的核心，但智能体编程需要的不仅仅是匹配自然语言查询到孤立代码片段。面对用户请求，编码智能体需要导航具体的代码库状态，定位相关文件和函数，收集支持性上下文，并过滤仓库内相似干扰项。现有的代码检索基准主要评估文档字符串到函数或片段级别的匹配，从而忽略了这种需求驱动的仓库搜索问题。为解决这一空白，我们引入了CORE-Bench，一个面向智能体编程时代代码检索的综合基准。CORE-Bench在三个层面评估代码检索能力：代码理解、问题到编辑定位以及更广泛的上下文检索。基于精选的代码搜索任务和SWE-bench系列实例构建，CORE-Bench包含超过18万条查询和10.6万个更广泛上下文的相关性标签。代表性实验表明...
tldr: CORE-Bench提出了一个涵盖代码理解、问题定位和上下文检索三个层面的综合基准，填补了智能体编程中需求驱动代码检索评估的空白。
en_tdlr: CORE-Bench introduces a comprehensive benchmark covering code understanding, issue localization, and context retrieval, filling the gap in evaluating requirement-driven code retrieval for agentic coding.
